hero.headline: AI agents, wired into real systems.
hero.subline: I build the harness in between: MCP servers, agent workflows and typed SDKs.

briefing.text: I build AI-first products: systems where agents, workflows and APIs are part of the architecture from the first commit, not a chatbot added later. Most of my open-source work is the harness that lets agents operate real systems safely.
principles: Typed SDKs instead of fragile scripts
